review_notes: Corrected s038/s039: the previous reading supplied the phrase's one *the* onto the construct בַּת and marked the article on הַמֶּלֶךְ unrepresented. The rectum is rendered anarthrously as *king Jehoram*, which is rule 29's fronting case, so the article takes the written *the* and the construct keeps only *daughter*; rule 29's last sentence permits an unrepresented article only where the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase at all.

s004–s006 is the arthrous case and is unaffected: the ASV writes *of the king*, so nothing is fronted, the article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one. The two phrases in this verse differ in the determiner standing before the rectum's word, which is the count rule 29 runs on each phrase separately.

s031 and s033 fuse into *bedchamber* under rule 30, each lexeme standing inside the one English word; the competing reading was to head the pair on the rectum, which rule 23 resolves to the governing construct since both lexemes are written. s051 and s052 fuse into *from* on the same terms, headed on the construct.
Both marginal notes were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.
